ms.code:
import pandas as pd

# List of source CSV file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/training_8.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/training_9.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/training_10.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly ['code', 'name'] and types match target schema
    df = df[['code', 'name']].copy()
    # Convert 'code' to integer type explicitly
    df['code'] = df['code'].astype(int)
    # Convert 'name' to string type explicitly
    df['name'] = df['name'].astype(str)
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all source DataFrames vertically
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# The target schema is ['code': integer, 'name': string]
# Ensure the final DataFrame matches the target schema types
target_df['code'] = target_df['code'].astype(int)
target_df['name'] = target_df['name'].astype(str)

# Write the result to the specified output path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/target_multisource.csv"
target_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
